_doc: Per-layer source products, endpoints, licences and attribution (R-004 §1). Bound by T-003. Licence ids are SPDX or US-Gov-PD. Changing a product here changes the bake fingerprint.

cudem.licence_note: Not subject to copyright protection within the United States (NCEI metadata).
cudem.attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) CUDEM

dep3_1m.licence_note: USGS data are in the U.S. public domain.

osm.licence_note: Open Database License 1.0. Credit required; derivative databases share-alike (Q-023).
osm.attribution_notice: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
osm.commercial_use: yes (with attribution; share-alike on derivative databases)

osm_water.licence_note: Derived from OpenStreetMap coastline data; ODbL 1.0.
osm_water.commercial_use: yes (with attribution; share-alike on derivative databases)

datasf.licence_note: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License 1.0 (verified from api/views/ynuv-fyni.json, R-004 §1.4).
datasf.attribution: City and County of San Francisco

assessor.product: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls wv5m-vpq2
assessor.columns_confirmed_from: https://data.sfgov.org/api/views/wv5m-vpq2.json (fieldName list, confirmed 2026-11-14; T-020 add-on, R-021 Q-NEW-b)
assessor.roll_year_note: Newest closed_roll_year in the dataset at 2026-11-14 (max(closed_roll_year) = 2025, 211547 rows). Pinned so the bake is deterministic; bump deliberately.
assessor.struct_class_note: construction_type is the Assessor construction-type code passed through raw; no mapping to Hazus classes is made here.
assessor.licence_note: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License 1.0 (api/views/wv5m-vpq2.json licenseId PDDL).
assessor.attribution: City and County of San Francisco, Office of the Assessor-Recorder

qfaults.product: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database (2020 release), ArcGIS REST haz/Qfaults layers 4 (CA) and 5 (CA offshore)
qfaults.licence_note: USGS data are in the U.S. public domain.
qfaults.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey Quaternary Fault and Fold Database

tides.product: NOAA CO-OPS station 9414290 San Francisco datums (NTDE 1983-2001)

ngs.product: NOAA NGS NDE radial benchmark query (NAVD88 heights)

lidar_ept.product: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23 (Entwine EPT on AWS usgs-lidar-public)
lidar_ept.use: reference only (M-005.7 R-ind first-return DSM), not shipped

unused._doc: Evaluated and not used at M0 (R-004 §1.4): licence fine but adds no better SF heights, or bulk-only.
unused.overture_buildings: ODbL + per-source credits: not used at M0
unused.coned_sfbay_tbdem: US-Gov-PD but a single 12.39 GB zip (no windowed access): not used
